triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER profile_link_club_owner BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF owner_id ON public.clubs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION profile_link_private.guard_club_owner()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION profile_link_private.guard_club_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if current_user in ('anon','authenticated') and ((TG_OP = 'INSERT' and new.owner_id is distinct from auth.uid()) or (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' and new.owner_id is distinct from old.owner_id)) then raise exception 'グループ所有者を変更できません'; end if;
  return new;
end $function$
